rationale: No Set improved beyond the A/A spread on DSP average or typical peak (Inbuilts -0.3/+0.5, Max4Live -0.1/+0.5, VSTs -0.2/+0.5 pt); PipeWire errors 63 (A) vs 73 (B) and peaks over 100% 18 vs 18 across 15 Set-runs per arm. hypothesis: pipeasio-rt, the thread that starts every audio block, runs SCHED_OTHER under PipeASIO's shipped realtime=false while all of Live's threads run SCHED_RR 10 (launcher chrt -r 10), so it waits about 650 ms per 30 s for a CPU; PIPEASIO_REALTIME=1 removes that wait and with it late blocks and dropouts.

hypothesis: Live's 15 AudioCalc workers plus the PipeASIO callback queue 4-5 s per 120 s for 12 logical P-core CPUs on 6 physical cores (T0004/T0005); six workers, one pinned to each physical P-core (ABLETON_MAX_AUDIO_THREADS=6, Live's own -MaxAudioThreads), remove the queueing and most of the fan-out wake-ups and lower DSP load and dropouts. Pre-registered: the T0004 rule ([D] DSP gain beyond 2x the A/A spread on a heavy Set, or [E] PipeWire errors <= 0.6 x A with one-sided binomial p < 0.05; guards: no DSP regression beyond 2x spread, total PipeWire errors not higher in B).

rationale: Pre-registered rule FAIL on the error guard: [D] PASS (VSTs median DSP average -1.75 points = 2.03x its A/A spread; Inbuilts -1.30, Max4Live -0.51, all lower), DSP guard PASS, but total PipeWire errors 13 -> 17 (B fewer in 4 of 9 pairs), concentrated in Max4Live (2,1,1 -> 0,5,5). The default stays at Live's 15 workers (T0007 runs on that base, as pre-registered). Largest efficiency gain so far: Live CPU median 64.0 % -> 40.1 % of one core (-37 %; VSTs 62.6-64.0 -> 33.0-34.8), AudioCalc CPU wait 3.6-5.4 s -> 21-705 ms per 120 s. Mechanism held: 6 workers in every B Set-run, each on its own physical P-core. Open question: is the Max4Live error rise real (fewer workers lengthen its critical path) or noise; a confirmation with longer windows, or a middle worker count, would decide.

hypothesis: wineserver runs SCHED_OTHER while all of Live runs SCHED_RR 10 (the launcher's chrt does not cover it); it waited 0.24-0.48 s per 120 s for a CPU while woken ~4 times per audio block, the inversion pattern pipeasio-rt had before T0003. Running it at SCHED_RR 10 removes that wait and with it late blocks. Pre-registered: the T0004 rule; both arms on the kept configuration and, as T0006 failed, Live's 15 workers.
